billing_estimate_basis.note: Based on the latest distinct NYSEG billing periods. The observed post-solar minimum is retained each month; the estimate excludes prior balances, payment plans, and NYSEG statement adjustments.

credit_bank_forecast.confidence: Limited winter history — medium confidence for the next 90 days; lower beyond that.
credit_bank_forecast.assumptions: Measured Sunrun production calibrated to Yorktown solar elevation and daylight. Household demand uses separate normal, cooling, and heating components; optional electric heat is not assumed to run continuously.

annual_solar_validation.note: The 11,141 kWh Sunrun production guarantee is a reference, not a hard cap. The forecast is calibrated to measured 2026 production and should be reconciled as a full year of data becomes available.

reconciliation.annual_settlement_status: No NYSEG annual settlement, expiration, or conversion rule is configured. The forecast preserves kWh credits until an official statement or confirmed tariff rule changes them.

credit_bank_forecast.root_cause: The prior forecast independently extrapolated M01 and M02 from a reversed daily list, which selected July/August as its recent baseline and allowed winter export to grow without a production or demand constraint.
